evidence: The films were deposited at a Td of 260 and 370°C on p-type Si(100) wafers... The chamber pressure was maintained below 0.3 Torr. To completely remove the residual source or oxidant, relatively long intervals of 8 and 30 s were used for the purge of TMA and H2O, respectively.
